newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells minor share packages at auction.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells minor share packages at auction.

text.p: Croatia's privatisation agency sold minority packages in two firms at an auction on Thursday, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported.
It said 224 shares in brewery Karlovacka Pivovara went to IB Austria's brokers for a total of 83,938 kuna. The final price was raised five percent from the asking price after bidding.
An 11-share package in shoe shops Legant was sold at face value for 7,851 kuna to private Glumina Banka acting as broker.

The interest for remaining state assets has waned after the most attractive firms went, some at a discount for public debt bonds. This was the first auction since March, when an 18.61 percent stake in a smaller trade firm was sold. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
